title: Earnings | BlueFocus 2022: ¥36.683B Revenue — Strategy All-in AI
summary: On April 19, 2023, ChiNext marketing-tech firm BlueFocus (SZSE: 300058) reported FY2022: revenue ¥36.683B (−8.47% YoY), net profit −¥2.175B (−516.85%). Paradox: secondary market surged — share price from ¥5.05 early-2023 to ¥13.08 by Apr 30 (+159.01%).
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / earnings analysis · June 16, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub

On April 19, 2023, ChiNext marketing-tech firm BlueFocus (SZSE: 300058) reported FY2022: revenue ¥36.683B (−8.47% YoY), net profit −¥2.175B (−516.85%). Paradox: secondary market surged — share price from ¥5.05 early-2023 to ¥13.08 by Apr 30 (+159.01%).

01 Core businesses

Founded 1996, Beijing HQ, listed 2010. 3,000+ clients across gaming, auto, internet/apps, ecommerce, hi-tech, CPG, real estate, finance. Three pillars: (1) full-case promotion (digital, PR, events); (2) full-case ad agency (digital buy, China go-global, OTT); (3) martech (virtual humans/goods, AIGC, virtual spaces, xR studios).

Agency brands: Domob, AdChina Mobile, BlueOcean, Bojie, Jingzhun — Data+, DSP, DMP, UGdesk, Luban. Meta / Google / TikTok for Business / LinkedIn / Twitter one-stop go-global. Metaverse “Blue Universe”: virtual IPs (Su Xiaomei, musician K, guofeng girl group Wuyin); BLUEBOX xR / virtual studios / Blue Universe spaces; MEME digital collectibles. AIGC SaaS: BlueFocus Smart Broadcast, Fen Shen You Shu (分身有术); Xiaobot suite — Creative Gallery, Chuangce text/image, AutoSlogan, Xiao Assistant. PRovoke 2021 Top10 marketing holding groups #8; WARC 2022 Top10 best holding companies #8 — only Chinese firm in both.

02 Financials

Bridge between advertisers and media — service fees + media rebates. 2022 China ad market ~−9.4% (QuestMobile; social retail ¥43.97T −0.2%). Mix: full-case promotion ¥6.520B (17.77%, +5.92 ppt share); full-case agency ¥3.793B (10.34%, +14.48%); go-global ads ¥25.370B (71.89%, −7.13%). Verticals: gaming ¥17.406B (47.45%); ecommerce ¥9.044B (24.60%, +22.96%); internet/apps ¥4.716B (12.86%, −32.46%). Direct internet clients 5,361→6,207 but revenue 370.5→347.7B; retention 61%→57%. Agency clients 957→748; revenue 30.27→19.15B; retention 55%→52%. Quarters ~¥10B each — budget cadence stable.

Impairment shock: −¥2.175B profit on client budget cuts (internet/auto/RE), lower media rebates, delayed spend, plus ¥2.038B goodwill/intangible/other impairments. 132 cumulative M&As since listing (Choice); 2021 international disposal took ¥1.834B goodwill off books; 2022 digital ads ¥787M + mobile media ¥400M + Madhouse ~¥86M impairments. Post-charge goodwill ¥1.756B = 23.68% of equity — leverage risk down.

Direct clients ~95% of sales. Go-global >70% (~¥26.370B). Top-5 clients ¥5.228B (14.25%); largest 4.11% — low concentration.

03 Comps

Most China integrated-marketing peers saw 2022 revenue decline (BlueFocus largest absolute drop; Huayang deepest %). BlueFocus GM only ~1.5% — go-global CPM/CPC buy/sell with media-vs-client rebate spread, heavy discounts to grow share, strict Meta/Google rebate policies. Contrast Yidian Tianxia CPA model (higher GM, conversion risk). Opex relatively low on scale + intelligent tools; R&D among lowest peers — likely to rise with AIGC push. Liquidity mid-pack: quick 1.29 / current 1.32 / D/A 59.15%.

04 AIGC & strategy

ISO27001; 150 SW copyrights; 26 patents granted / 25 pending; 100+ trademarks. Dec 2022: lead on 14th Five-Year national R&D project for real-time high-fidelity twin digital humans. iResearch: AI core industry >¥600B by 2026, related ¥2.1077T.

Mar 2023: BlueFocus Media × Microsoft Advertising official agency (New Bing genAI marketing); applying as Azure marketing ISV for OpenAI-based products. Baidu Ernie Bot first-wave ecosystem partner — Su Xiaomei dialogue upgrade; Smart Broadcast / Fen Shen You Shu / MEME production lifts. CEO Pan Fei: no rebuild of foundation models — focus industry models + app-layer tool matrix.

Apr 12 East China ops memo: indefinite halt of outsourcing for creative design, proposals, copywriting, short-term hires — “stop hollowing core capability; lay All-in AIGC groundwork” — potentially saving tens of millions RMB/year. Xiaobot “Chuangce text/image” suite for end-to-end creative/plan/copy/image gen.

Go-global: official reseller Meta/Google/TikTok/Twitter; Luban Cross-Border Tong (2019) for Google account create, multi-currency pay, MCC, analytics — 2022Q1 +3,000 new users; lifetime >20k SMEs 0→1; FY revenue >¥600M, >6,000 users, >30k cumulative clients. “721” plan: 7 = stabilize existing (globalization core); 2 = “marketing + sales” incremental; 1 = All-in AI new business.

Xiaohongshu full-funnel center: brand / Puhongying / auto vertical licenses; GMV orders +900% YoY; 2023 Will conference growth partner award; BlueGrow system + CPS spillover index. Blue Starhe KOL unit: custom creative + data + CPS — 2022 volume ¥290M; Double-11 CPS GMV ~10× YoY; 180+ brands. Xiaohongshu + Starhe + Ying+Xiao expected >¥1B incremental in 2023 as second curve.

05 Risks & summary

Competition (low barriers, tech-driven media); talent churn in people-dense industry. Thesis: AIGC as “internet+” moment for marketing; Microsoft partnership cards future ad inventory; scale + data/social tools deepen client stickiness. Pan Fei: AIGC/AGI “raises the ceiling” by liberating talented teams via productivity shift.

16 CN charts/images; attach on ingest. Author Jianpan · Review Ski.

— END —
